{{Quote|We've been trying to let people know that the Jrade is once again open. I guess people are still shaken up by it all.|Dassa Borkannits|<ref name="Holonet" />}}
'''Dassa Borkannits''' was the Director of Communications for the [[Jrade District/Legends|Jrade District]] of the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Holonet" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:01:13]]" places the unveiling of the [[Finis Valorum Memorial]] in 15:01:13, which corresponds to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> a [[Finis Valorum Memorial|memorial]] statue for former [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], who had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[terrorist attack of 14:9:19]], was planned for the [[Jrade Plaza]] [[Chancellery Walkway]] in the Jrade District. The development caused the plaza to be shut down for several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] for security investigations. When the memorial was unveiled to a small crowd of only 200 people, Borkannits stated to [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] that they had been trying to inform the public that Jrade Plaza was reopened, speculating that they were still frightened by recent events. Borkannits' statements were included in the 15:01:13 [[HoloNet News Core Edition]].<ref name="Holonet" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dassa Borkannits was mentioned in "[[Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:01:13]]," an [[in-universe]] news report written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 73|seventy-third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Holonet" /> on [[December 26]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/12/news20031219.html|text=Mark Hamill On Stage In ''Insider'' #73}}</ref> "[[The Lost One]]," an episode of the [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''<ref name="The Lost One">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref> that first aired on [[March 1]], [[2014]],<ref name="Air date">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fernsehserien.de/star-wars-the-clone-wars/episodenguide/staffel-6/9660|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars Staffel 6 Episodenguide|work=[https://www.fernsehserien.de fernsehserien.de]|archivedate=20190419012747}}</ref> portrayed Valorum as alive<ref name="The Lost One" /> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Fact File">{{FactFile2014|60|20 BBY 67-70|Sifo-Dyas' Legacy}} places the events of "[[The Lost One]]" in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> contradicting his previously established death in 21 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]] and leaving the [[canon]]icity of Borkannits' involvement with the Finis Valorum Memorial in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity uncertain.<ref name="Date" />
